changes.newText: Superadmins can control how long Backend.AI keeps each kind of record on the Data Retention tab of the Maintenance page. Old records are cleaned up only for categories whose policy is enabled.
changes.newHtml: Superadmins can control how long Backend.AI keeps each kind of record on the Data Retention tab of the Maintenance page. Old records are cleaned up only for categories whose policy is enabled.

changes.newText: Each row of the list is the policy for one category and shows its Category, Retention Period (Days), an Enabled switch, and the Last Cleanup time (or "Not run yet"). The Created At and Updated At columns can be shown from the table settings. The available categories are Logs, Login History, Reconcile History, Roles & Invitations, Deployments, Sessions, Usage Records, and Usage Buckets. The list can be sorted by Category, Last Cleanup, or Created At.
changes.newHtml: Each row of the list is the policy for one category and shows its Category, Retention Period (Days), an Enabled switch, and the Last Cleanup time (or "Not run yet"). The Created At and Updated At columns can be shown from the table settings. The available categories are Logs, Login History, Reconcile History, Roles & Invitations, Deployments, Sessions, Usage Records, and Usage Buckets. The list can be sorted by Category, Last Cleanup, or Created At.

changes.newText: Create Policy: Click Create Policy, choose a category, enter a retention period of at least 1 day, and choose whether the policy is enabled. Only one policy can exist per category; creating a policy for a category that already has one fails with an error, so edit the existing policy instead.
changes.newHtml: Create Policy: Click Create Policy, choose a category, enter a retention period of at least 1 day, and choose whether the policy is enabled. Only one policy can exist per category; creating a policy for a category that already has one fails with an error, so edit the existing policy instead.

changes.newText: Edit: Use the edit action in the row to change the category, the retention period, or the enabled setting. Moving the policy to a category that already has a policy fails with an error.
changes.newHtml: Edit: Use the edit action in the row to change the category, the retention period, or the enabled setting. Moving the policy to a category that already has a policy fails with an error.

changes.newText: Enabled switch: Turn a policy on or off directly from the list, without opening the editor.
changes.newHtml: Enabled switch: Turn a policy on or off directly from the list, without opening the editor.

changes.newText: Delete: Use the delete action in the row. Because the policy is removed permanently, you must type the category name shown in the dialog before the delete button is enabled.
changes.newHtml: Delete: Use the delete action in the row. Because the policy is removed permanently, you must type the category name shown in the dialog before the delete button is enabled.
